title: Basic Baby Blanket
description: A soft repetitive blanket project designed for steady rows and easy progress tracking.
expectationText: A longer-form comfort project that turns simple repeated rows into a gift-ready blanket without introducing difficult shaping.

steps.title: Chain the width
steps.instruction: Make a foundation chain wide enough for a baby blanket and count carefully before the first row.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Work the setup row evenly across and mark the first and last stitches if edge counting is still new.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 20
steps.instruction: Repeat the main stitch pattern, checking the edges every few rows so the blanket stays rectangular.

steps.title: Rows 21 to 40
steps.instruction: Continue building height and change colors only at the end of a row if you want soft stripes.

steps.title: Add the border
steps.instruction: Work a simple border around all four sides to tidy the edges and corners.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in the ends and lay the blanket flat to check that the border sits smoothly.
